capture.zh: SPT面板选择螺旋星系→斯利普→现在就去，来到上古龙殿，点击沉睡中的斯利普挑战；打败获得斯利普精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 没有明显强化、吃属性相克，较好打：凯洛亚水之结界弱化/补血→斯加尔卡自杀→盖亚返璞归真强化后石破天惊秒杀；战斗系精灵有效。

engine_notes: 4399: 每回合容易给我方精灵造成睡眠和害怕状态. Fear fits 展翅冲锋 (15%). No move of the Boss causes sleep: in the 2012 battle logs the sleep appears right after the player's own move, so it is a Boss effect (server effect index 107, shared with 普兰特). It is not modelled.

skills: all four appear in the Boss's battle log in 4399's 2012 fight video (id 120526): 混沌惩戒, 震怒之魂, 展翅冲锋, 龙怒乾坤, which are species 1164's last four at or below Lv80. The former fourth move 打盹 was a guess; it is named only as a learnable move in a player-build article (4399 2012-04-28), never as a Boss move.
速度极慢 — spe x0.5 estimate.
HP and level not measured by the guide (作者用盖亚秒杀); estimates.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
source_note: 4399 guide 2012-04-27: slow, frequent sleep/fear, no innate boost; HP 'not measured'.
